label: HUMAN AUTHORIZATION
heading: Your approval stays separate
intro: This dedicated page will confirm the exact administrative action before you authorize it with a passkey.
disabledDetail: The executor is still being prepared. Registering a passkey does not enable or run any command.
setupMissing: Open the single-use invitation created from the administrator terminal to register this device.
setupReady: This invitation was created from the administrator terminal. Register a passkey using Face ID, Touch ID or your authenticator. The administrator must then finish verification in the terminal.
waiting: Follow the instructions on your device…
staged: Response received. Finish verification in the administrator terminal. Commands remain disabled.
cancelled: Registration was cancelled or timed out. You can try again while the invitation is valid.
unavailable: The invitation is expired, already used or unavailable. Create a new one from the administrator terminal.
unsupported: Passkey registration is unavailable in this browser. Open this HTTPS page in Safari on your device.
network: Unable to confirm the result. Check the connection and ask the administrator to check the invitation before trying again.
footer: No sudo password is requested or sent. Placet agents cannot authorize actions through this page.
